name: author-site
title: Author Site
description: The site of one manga series, made only with mangacn: its volumes (VolumeCards, an ObiBand for the volume still to come), the week's releases, the most read chapters and the shelf, then the series page and the chapter. Reader: Page by page with PageReader or Panel by panel with GuidedView (a pressed toggle), both fed by the same chapter written as page data (PageData: panels, pictures, real bubbles, captions and sound effects); all pages in PageThumbnails and ReaderSettings (order, mode, fit, background) in Sheets from the toolbar, the strip mode as pages one under the other, and a ChapterEnd after the last page leading to the next chapter (or its date, or the end of the series) and back to the series. Each screen slides in; reading progress is remembered per series for Continue. Works at 375 px, in light and dark, with any accent.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/author-site". The works, chapters and pages are data at the top of the file: replace SERIES with your series and chapterPages() with your chapters as PageData (or give PageReader and GuidedView scans). The three screens are the component's state: wire show() to your router to give each one a URL. The block ships no image: pass the volume covers and one picture per kind of panel in art (without them, covers are screentone and panels stay empty).

meta.tagline: A manga author's site: catalog, series page, then the chapter read page by page or panel by panel.
